verdict.rationale: Square ships AI features (Square AI assistant, ML fraud detection), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product, but the evidence pack contains no documented control or policy that keeps seller or customer data out of model training. Scoped OAuth permissions and the MCP server's read-only mode govern access, not training use, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
